name: Splinterspear Junction
summary: Horde sentries hold Splinterspear Junction where the Swamp of Sorrows road forks. North lies the Harborage and Fallow Sanctuary; south, the road passes Stonard toward the Blasted Lands.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Conflict
sections.body:
At Splinterspear Junction, the road through the Swamp of Sorrows divides. The northern trail leads toward the Lost One refuge of the Harborage and the Fallow Sanctuary. South, the road passes Stonard on its way to the Blasted Lands.

An ancient orcish watchtower overlooks the fork. Horde troops hold it and patrol the roads. For Horde travelers, the tower offers a secure point in a treacherous marsh. For Alliance travelers, it is a deadly ambush on an unforgiving trail.

faq.q: Where do the roads at Splinterspear Junction lead?
faq.answer: North, the fork leads toward the Lost One refuge of the Harborage and the Fallow Sanctuary. South, the road passes Stonard and continues to the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: Is Splinterspear Junction safe for Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: No. Horde troops hold the junction, garrison its watchtower, and patrol the roads. Openly hostile to the Alliance, they attack passing adventurers on sight.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, watch your step at Splinterspear Junction. Horde sentries guard the orcish watchtower and are eager to cut down intruders straying from Darkshire.
As a Horde traveler, use the watchtower at Splinterspear Junction as a vital waypoint and security checkpoint on the road between Stonard and northern destinations in the swamp.
